rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun in feminine plural nominative referring to the goddesses named previously
second-person pronoun in accusative singular as the one to be anointed
imperative plural active of abhiṣiñc, directing the goddesses to perform anointing
instrumental adjective phrase modifying water, indicating purification by mantra
neuter noun in instrumental singular naming the anointing substance

items.question: Who is to anoint the recipient and with what purified substance?
premises: The goddesses are named as agents.
items.inference: The verse prescribes anointing of the recipient by the goddesses using water purified by mantra.
uncertainties: The exact gender and number agreement of mantra pūtena with vāriṇā is not fully explicit in the token.
items.plain_english: Let these goddesses anoint you with water purified by mantra.
